official_scope: UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions estimates
main_official_inputs: DESNZ official statistics on energy consumption for local authority areas
allocation_limitations: The dataset is local-authority level, not parcel level.
No parcel-specific emission_percent may be asserted from these rows without a separately evidenced allocation model.
Aviation, shipping and military transport are excluded where there is no obvious basis for local allocation.
Fluorinated gases are excluded where suitable local-level estimation data are unavailable.
